title: Kick Lattice
premise: The lattices from the hymn, already assembled, hop on a 150 BPM kick. The camera is locked. Black exists only as a one-frame punch. The core stays matte.
visual: Dark void, no floor. Four brass wireframe cubes and one icosahedron nested on a shared origin, a matte coal-orange core. No slow scale-in — they are already on the job. No HUD, no nebula, no faces, no rays.
motion: Locked 3/4 camera the whole 16s. Forty kicks at 150 BPM (0.4s). Each kick: one black frame, shells snap 15°, core pulses, sparks jump a radius. Never an orbit. Loop on kick zero.

notes: Fast sibling of Lattice Hymn. Do not steal the slow orbit. Keep the core matte. In-hub sequence is procedural WebGL.
